scope: All 35 supported templates; selected factory and transitive vehicle provider packages, supplemented by shared transport/auth and external SDK reviews. Source graph is an overapproximation; unselected factories are not instantiated.

external_reviews.github.com/joeshaw/carwings@v0.0.0-20250: carwings.go uses fixed AES key/IV for login; caller-provided HTTP client is used; explicit legacy opt-in.
external_reviews.github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2: Fiat Cognito config.WithHTTPClient now pins caller request client; SigV4 uses SDK cryptography.
external_reviews.github.com/eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang: BMW supplies transport.SecureTLSConfig to MQTT options before connection.
external_reviews.github.com/teslamotors/vehicle-command: Fleet HTTP uses caller-provided client; no command session or control method is invoked by the engine.
